text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, August 1, 2018 Posted by admin on August 1st, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Pfizer (PFE). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -8 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +108.36 (+0.43%) at 25,415.19.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.82%.
There were 11 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by 3M (MMM) +3.51% and Pfizer (PFE) +3.47%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Walgreens (WBA) -2.23% and Verizon (VZ) -1.62%.
Apple (AAPL +0.20%) climbed more than 3% in premarket trading after it forecast Q4 revenue of $60 billion to $62 billion, above consensus of $59.4 billion.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up seven-tenths of a cent at $2.869 per gallon.
